findings.claim: renounceOwnership sets platformRenounced=true before super.renounceOwnership(); a revert in super would strand the flag true with an active owner.
findings.challenge: Read OZ Ownable.sol: renounceOwnership only writes _owner storage and emits; no external calls, no revert path. Ordering is safe.

findings.claim: MovieTicket never executes the renounce redirect branch — post-renounce mints revert first.
findings.challenge: Both paid entry points are onlyOwner; post-renounce owner=address(0) cannot sign, so no MovieTicket sale can ever occur post-renounce — the revert assertion is the correct coverage; shared branch covered by the other three contracts.

findings.claim: No dedicated PlatformRenounced event — indexers must infer renounce from OwnershipTransferred(zero).
findings.challenge: super emits OwnershipTransferred(zero) and platformRenounced is a public getter; redundant event has no acceptance measure (no demonstrated indexing problem).
